description: Returns QuBe Sync's integration checklist as Markdown: the 53 rules an app integrating with QuBe Sync has to get right (verifying webhook signatures on the raw body, answering 2xx within 5 seconds and working in a job, a new run reference saved before the start, revisions and delivery ids, never answering a run's question for the user, QuickBooks ids keyed by their connection and list, lost answers, webhooks not polling...). Each has an id, a severity, when it applies, why, what to check in the code, what wrong and right look like, and its docs. Read it before writing or reviewing an integration's webhook handler, run starts or stored QuickBooks ids. Pass `area` for one area's rules. To audit a whole codebase, a coding agent can follow the audit skill at https://qubesync.com/skills/qube-sync-audit/SKILL.md, which has every rule.

area.description: One area's rules only: onboarding (Onboarding); starting-runs (Calling the API and starting runs); webhooks (Webhooks); questions (Questions and endings); data (Stored QuickBooks data); quickbooks (QuickBooks behaviour); going-live (Going live). Leave it out for every rule.
